set.body: Implement a prospectively frozen GazeWeave-Replay reliability gate for the Wynn full 3000-ms recognition window. Integrate all four study presentations as separate equal-weight likelihood components without invented cross-trial transitions; stabilize nonmatch evidence with exhaustive held-out within-participant candidate pools or a demonstrated repeated-panel approximation; learn response-blind candidate-invariant shrinkage toward the candidate prior from path support; expose generic gaze quality separately from item-specific gaze_info_bits. Assess fixation-count impact as a prespecified reliability diagnostic, not a response-selected subgroup. Do not refit behavior until the measurement score and invariants are frozen. Done when analytic/metamorphic/edge tests pass, repeated-viewing sensitivity is preserved, retrieval proper-score reliability is evaluated out of fold, runtime is recorded, and private outputs remain local-only.
set.title: GW-17 Stabilize Replay with multi-presentation evidence
